spans.text: OpenSentience — Research Protocols for Machine Cognition
Research arm of [&] Ampersand Box Design. Publishes theoretical foundations, empirical protocols, and open questions that guide the [&] product ecosystem.

OS-009 (PRISM) and OS-010 (PULSE) are sibling cross-cutting protocols. PRISM is the diagnostic algebra (measures loops over time). PULSE is the temporal algebra (declares how loops cycle). GRASP is the sensorimotor behavioral protocol for
providers — closes the perception-action gap by defining the typed
loop. Together with the eight cognitive primitives (OS-001 through OS-008) and the [&] structural composition layer, they form the complete protocol stack.
— Agent Harness Protocol (pipeline enforcement, quality gates, sprint contracts, context management)
— PRISM Protocol for Rating Iterative System Memory (9 CL dimensions, 4-phase evaluation loop, BYOR, IRT calibration)
— PULSE Protocol for Uniform Loop State Exchange (loop manifest schema, 5 canonical phase kinds, 6 canonical tokens as of v0.1.1, 7 invariants, BYOL)
— GRASP, the Grounded Readings, Actions and State Protocol (typed perceive/act/affordances/encode_state/replay loop for
, InteractionTrace schema, SurpriseSignal PULSE token, 5 invariants, 12 conformance tests)
— Empirical Evaluation of Topology-Aware Continual Learning (Graphonomous benchmark on [&] portfolio)
OpenSentience defines the theoretical protocols; [&] portfolio companies implement them
Graphonomous implements OS-001 (continual learning) and is the canonical PULSE substrate for
AmpersandBoxDesign implements OS-002 through OS-005 as prompts and contracts
Delegatic implements OS-006 (governance) and is the canonical PULSE substrate for
OS-008 (Harness) sits above OS-006 — enforces pipeline ordering, quality gates, and governance contracts at runtime
